pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with relatively sharp edge gradients. Geometry transitions from smaller, more rounded shapes on the neck/shoulder to larger, more angular blocks on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored network with high topological continuity. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pathways maintain a relatively consistent pixel width with occasional narrowing at acute patch vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the neck line, indicating a short, dense mane structure against the background.
